about: WIDE sample for scripts/rerun/rerun.py bench (scripts/rerun/wide_sample.py sample): whole sessions of small sample zones w_<name> spread over the sky conditions (zodiacal glow, ecliptic poles, galactic plane and bulge, Magellanic Clouds, high-latitude sky, time), none holding a bench or hold-out photo. Same format as bench_targets.json; `box` is the zone's RA/Dec box (its photo list photolists/zones/<zone>.parquet and its catalogue truth cover it).
